 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This PERMITTED BDC TRANSFER PURCHASE AND CONTRIBUTION AGREEMENT, dated as of
October&nbsp;27, 2026 (as amended, supplemented or otherwise modified and in effect from time to time, this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;), between SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND INC., a Maryland corporation, as seller (in such capacity, the
&#8220;<U>Seller</U>&#8221;) and SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND SPV I LP, a Delaware limited partnership, as purchaser (in such capacity, the &#8220;<U>Purchaser</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><U>W</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;I</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;T</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;N</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;E</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;S</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;
S</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;E</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;T</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;H</U>: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Purchaser desires to purchase certain loans and related
assets from time to time; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Seller desires to sell, assign and convey such loans and related assets to the Purchaser upon the
terms and conditions hereinafter set forth; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, it is the Seller&#8217;s and the Purchaser&#8217;s intention that each conveyance of
the Transferred Assets hereunder is a &#8220;true sale&#8221; for all purposes, such that, upon payment of the Asset Purchase Price therefor, the Transferred Assets will constitute property of the Purchaser from and after the applicable Conveyance
Date; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Seller owns 100% of the outstanding limited partnership units of the Purchaser; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, it is hereby agreed by and
between the Purchaser and the Seller as follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE I </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>DEFINITIONS </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 1.1
<U>Definitions</U>. As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the following meanings (such meanings to be equally applicable to both the singular and plural forms of the terms defined). All capitalized terms used herein but not
defined herein shall have the respective meanings specified in, or incorporated by reference into, the Revolving Credit and Security Agreement, dated as of June&nbsp;17, 2026 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified and in effect
from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Credit </U><U>Agreement</U>&#8221;), by and among the Purchaser, as the Borrower, Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC, as the Servicer, Atlas Securitized Products Administration, L.P., as the Administrative Agent, Atlas
Securitized Products, L.P., as Lead Arranger, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as the Collateral Agent and the Collateral Administrator, U.S. Bank National Association, as the Custodian and the Document Custodian, each of the conduit
lenders and institutional lenders from time to time party thereto and each of the managing agents from time to time party thereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Asset Purchase Price</U>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;3.1</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Convey</U>&#8221; means to sell, transfer, assign or otherwise convey assets hereunder and &#8220;Conveyed&#8221; and
&#8220;Conveying&#8221; when used as a verb have correlative meanings. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Distribution</U>&#8221; means any payment of principal or interest, or any dividend or premium payment made on, or any other
distribution in respect of, a Transferred Asset. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Material Adverse Effect</U>&#8221; means, with respect to any event or

status, existence, perfection, priority or enforceability of the Purchaser&#8217;s lien (if any) on the Transferred Assets. </P>

Persons (other than a Governmental Authority). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Purchaser</U>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the preamble hereto. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Related Assets</U>&#8221; means, with respect to any Transferred Asset: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) if applicable, all present and future Liens of the Seller in any Related Property securing such Transferred Assets, as applicable, and all
recoveries related thereto (including all monies due, to become due and paid in respect thereof and liquidation proceeds thereof) and all other payments paid in respect thereof, and all financing statements and similar registrations and notices
covering any collateral subject to such security interests (including all UCC financing statements and other filings relating thereto); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) all guaranties, indemnities and warranties, insurance policies and other agreements or arrangements of whatever character from time to time
supporting or securing payment of any such Transferred Asset; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) all amounts due and to become due under such Transferred Asset,
including all Distributions; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) all rights, remedies, powers, privileges and claims under or in respect of such Transferred Asset
(whether arising pursuant to the terms thereof or otherwise available at law or in equity) and any Related Property, including the right of the Seller to ask, demand, sue for, collect, receive and enforce any and all monies now or hereafter payable
under such Transferred Asset and to enforce all other covenants, obligations, rights and remedies thereunder, except to the extent that any such rights indemnify against liability incurred by the Seller to others; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) all records with respect to such Transferred Asset, and any of the foregoing; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) all recoveries and proceeds of the foregoing. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Related Property</U>&#8221; means, with respect to any Transferred Asset, any property or other assets designated and pledged or
mortgaged by the related Obligor as collateral to secure repayment of such Transferred Asset. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<U>Repurchase Price</U>&#8221; has
the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;7.1</U>. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) reference to any Person includes such Person&#8217;s successors and assigns but, if applicable, only if such successors and assigns are
permitted by the Facility Documents; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) reference to any gender includes each other gender; </P>

form; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) reference to any agreement (including any Facility Documents), document or instrument means such agreement, document or
instrument as amended, modified, supplemented, replaced, restated, waived or extended and in effect from time to time in accordance with the terms thereof and, if applicable, the terms of the other Facility Documents, and reference to any promissory
note includes any promissory note that is an extension or renewal thereof or a substitute or replacement therefor; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) reference to any

 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-3- </P>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE II </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CONVEYANCES OF TRANSFERRED ASSETS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 2.1 <U>Conveyances</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) On the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement and the Credit Agreement, the Seller may from time to time Convey to
the Purchaser, and the Purchaser may from time to time purchase, on the applicable date of Conveyance as mutually agreed to by the Seller and the Purchaser (each such purchase and contribution being herein called a &#8220;<U>Conveyance</U>&#8221;),
all of the Seller&#8217;s right, title and interest (whether now existing, owned or hereinafter acquired or arising, and wherever located) in and to each Collateral Loan then Conveyed by the Seller to the Purchaser (as will be identified on
<U>Schedule A</U> to this Agreement (as such schedule may be amended, supplemented, updated or otherwise modified from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Schedule of Loans</U>&#8221;), which Schedule of Loans shall be delivered by the Seller to the
Purchaser for each such Conveyance) together with all proceeds of the foregoing. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) It is the express intent of the Seller and the
Purchaser that each Conveyance of Transferred Assets by the Seller to the Purchaser pursuant to this Agreement be construed as an absolute sale of such Transferred Assets by the Seller to the Purchaser. The Seller agrees that from time to time, at
the Purchaser&#8217;s expense, it will promptly execute and deliver all instruments and documents and take all actions as may be reasonably necessary or as the Purchaser may reasonably request, in order to perfect or protect the ownership interest
of the Purchaser in the Transferred Assets purchased hereunder or to enable the Purchaser to exercise or enforce any of its rights hereunder. Without limiting the foregoing, the Seller will, in order to accurately reflect the Conveyances
contemplated by this Agreement, execute and file such financing statements, continuation statements, financing change statements and amendments thereto or assignments thereof (as permitted pursuant hereto) or other documents or instruments as may be
reasonably requested by the Purchaser and mark its master computer records (or related <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-ledger)</FONT> noting the purchase by the Purchaser of the Transferred Assets and the Lien of the Collateral Agent pursuant
to the Credit Agreement. The Seller hereby authorizes the Purchaser to file and, to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law the Purchaser shall be permitted to sign (if necessary) and file, initial financing statements, continuation
statements, financing change statements and amendments thereto and assignments thereof without the Seller&#8217;s signature. Carbon, photographic or other reproduction of this Agreement or any financing statement shall be sufficient as a financing
statement. The Seller acknowledges receipt of an executed copy of this Agreement and, to the extent permitted by Applicable Law, waives the right to receive a copy of any financing statement or financing change statement registered in connection
with this Agreement or any verification statement issued with respect to any such financing statement or financing change statement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c)
Each of the Seller and the Purchaser agree that prior to the time of Conveyance of any Collateral Loans hereunder, the Purchaser has no rights to or claim of benefit from any Collateral Loans (or any interest therein) owned by the Seller. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) Each Conveyance of Transferred Assets by the Seller to the Purchaser pursuant to this Agreement shall be a &#8220;true sale&#8221; and/or
an absolute assignment and/or contribution of such Transferred Assets (including the entire beneficial and equitable interest in all Distributions and the right to receive such Distributions in respect of the related Collateral Loan) by the Seller
to the Purchaser providing the Purchaser with the full ownership interest in such Transferred Assets and the Purchaser shall be fully entitled to receive and retain for its own account any and all Distributions in respect of such Transferred Assets
(other than for consolidated accounting purposes or for federal and applicable state, provincial, territorial and local income tax reporting purposes). The Seller intends to relinquish all rights to possess, control and monitor the Transferred
Assets. The Purchaser shall have no obligation to account for, replace, substitute or return </P>

with the intention of removing them from the Seller&#8217;s estate pursuant to Debtor Relief Laws, including Section&nbsp;541 of the Bankruptcy Code. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) The Transferred Assets acquired, transferred to and assumed by the Purchaser from the Seller shall include the Seller&#8217;s entitlement
to any surplus or responsibility for any deficiency that, in either case, arises under, out of, in connection with, or as a result of, the foreclosure upon or acceleration of any such Transferred Assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) The Seller shall have no right hereunder to reacquire any of the Transferred Assets, and the Purchaser shall be entitled to dispose of any
Transferred Assets in its discretion (subject to the Credit Agreement) and shall have no duty or obligation to account to the Seller in respect thereof nor any recourse to the Seller in connection with any such disposition. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 2.2 <U>Indemnification</U>. Without limiting any other rights which any such Person may have hereunder or under Applicable Law, the

<U>Participation Interests</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) With respect to any Collateral Loan transferred hereunder as part of the Transferred Assets Conveyed,
pending the receipt of any required consents to, and the effectiveness of, the assignment of such Collateral Loan from the Seller to the Purchaser in accordance with the applicable Related Documents, the Seller hereby Conveys to the Purchaser and
the Purchaser hereby agrees to purchase an undivided 100% Participation Interest in such Collateral Loan and the Related Assets. The Participation Interests will not include any rights that are not permitted to be participated pursuant to the terms
of the Related Documents. Such sale and assignment of the Participation Interests shall constitute an absolute sale of each such Participation Interest. Each of the Participation Interests has the following characteristics: (i)&nbsp;the
Participation Interest represents an undivided participation interest in 100% of the underlying Collateral Loan and its proceeds (including Interest Proceeds and Principal Proceeds) and (ii)&nbsp;the Participation Interest represents a pass-through
of all of the payments made on the Collateral Loan (including the Interest Proceeds and Principal Proceeds) and will last for the same length of time as such loan. For the avoidance of doubt, each Participation Interest will terminate automatically
upon the Elevation Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Each of the Seller and the Purchaser shall use commercially reasonable efforts to, as soon as reasonably
practicable after the applicable Conveyance Date therefor, cause the Elevation of each Participation Interest and take such action as shall be mutually agreeable in connection therewith and in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Related
Documents and consistent with the terms of this Agreement. Each grant of a Participation Interest is intended to constitute an absolute conveyance, transfer and assignment of such Participation Interest, including all beneficial and economic
interests in the related Collateral Loan, from the Seller to the Purchaser, leaving the Seller with only &#8220;bare legal title&#8221; to such Collateral Loan and the proceeds and any Related Assets, such that such Participation Interest (including
such beneficial interest in the underlying Collateral Loan and the proceeds and any Related Assets) shall not be part of the Seller&#8217;s estate, as determined pursuant to Section&nbsp;541(d) of the Bankruptcy Code, in the event of the filing of a
bankruptcy petition by or against the Seller under any Debtor Relief Law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) Until the Elevation Date , the Seller shall direct the
underlying administrative agent or Obligor for each such Collateral Loan, as applicable, to send all Interest Proceeds and Principal Proceeds in respect of such Collateral Loan directly to the applicable Collection Account. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) Until the Elevation Date, the Seller shall comply with any written instructions provided to the Seller by or on behalf of the Purchaser
with respect to voting rights to be exercised by holders of the applicable Collateral Loan, other than with respect to any voting rights that are not permitted to be participated pursuant to the terms of the applicable Related Documents. </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 3.1 <U>Purchase Price</U>. The purchase price (the &#8220;<U>Asset </U><U>Purchase Price</U>&#8221;) for the Transferred Assets
Conveyed on each Conveyance Date shall be an amount equal to the fair market value (as agreed upon between the Seller and the Purchaser at the time of such Conveyance and, with respect to each Transferred Asset, will be set forth on the Data File
required to be delivered under the Credit Agreement) of such Transferred Assets as of such date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 3.2 <U>Payment of Purchase
Price</U>. The Asset Purchase Price shall be paid on the related Conveyance Date by the Purchaser issuing limited partner interests to the Seller and by adding to the Seller&#8217;s capital account in the Purchaser an amount equal to the unpaid
portion of the Asset Purchase Price. Upon the payment of the Asset Purchase Price for any Transferred Asset by the Purchaser to the Seller, such Transferred Asset shall be Conveyed to the Purchaser. </P>

Purchaser and, no such sale is or may be voidable or subject to avoidance under Title 11 of the Bankruptcy Code and the rules and regulations thereunder. In addition, no such Conveyance shall have been made with the intent to hinder or delay payment
to defraud any creditor of the Seller. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) <U>Not an Investment Company</U>. The Seller is not required to register as an

reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(n) <U>Taxes</U>. The Seller has timely filed or caused to be filed (taking into
account all applicable extensions) all income and other material tax returns and reports required to have been filed by it (if any), and has timely paid or caused to be paid (taking into account all applicable extensions) all income and other
material taxes required to have been paid by it (if any), except in either case where the failure to do so could not reasonably be expected to result, singly or in the aggregate, in a material adverse effect upon the Seller. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(o) <U>Backup Security Interest</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">i. In the event that, notwithstanding the intent of the parties, the Conveyances hereunder shall be characterized as loans and
not as sales, then this Agreement creates a valid and continuing Lien on the Transferred Assets in favor of the Purchaser and the Document Custodian, as assignee, for the benefit of the Secured Parties, and upon filing of the financing statements
referred to in clause (iii)&nbsp;below, such security interest is validly perfected under Article 9 of the UCC and is enforceable as such against creditors of and purchasers from the Seller except as enforceability may be limited by applicable
bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium or other similar laws affecting creditors&#8217; rights generally or general principles of equity, regardless of whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">ii. the Seller owns and has good and marketable title to the interest in the Transferred Assets sold to the Purchaser on the
applicable Conveyance Date, free and clear of any Lien (other than Permitted Liens); </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-9- </P>

filing of all appropriate financing statements in the proper filing office in the appropriate jurisdictions under Applicable Law in order to perfect the security interest in favor of the Purchaser in that portion of the Transferred Assets in which a
security interest may be perfected by filing pursuant to Article 9 of the UCC; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:5%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">iv. none of the underlying promissory
notes that constitute or evidence the Collateral Loans have any marks or notations indicating that they have been pledged, assigned or otherwise sold to any Person other than the Purchaser and the Document Custodian, as assignee on behalf of the
Secured Parties. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(p) <U>Solvency</U>. The Seller is Solvent and will be Solvent after giving effect to each Conveyance hereunder. The
Seller is paying its existing debts as they become due (subject to any applicable grace period) and, after giving effect to the transactions contemplated hereby, will have adequate capital to conduct its business. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(q) <U>Sanctions</U>. None of the Seller, or any of its Subsidiaries or any of the directors, officers, or, to the knowledge of the Seller,
employees of the Seller or any of its Subsidiaries is an individual or entity (&#8220;person&#8221;) that is, or is 50% or more owned or controlled by persons that are: (i)&nbsp;the target of any Sanctions or (ii)&nbsp;domiciled, organized or
resident in a country or territory that is the subject of comprehensive Sanctions (as of the date of this Agreement, the Crimea, the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">so-called</FONT> Luhansk People&#8217;s Republic and the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">so-called</FONT> Donetsk People&#8217;s Republic regions of Ukraine, Cuba, Iran and North Korea). The Seller and its Subsidiaries are in compliance with applicable Sanctions and Anti-Corruption Laws in all material
respects. The Seller has instituted and maintains policies and procedures designed to promote and achieve continued compliance with applicable Sanctions and Anti-Corruption Laws. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(r) <U>Ownership</U>. The Seller owns 100% of the outstanding limited partnership units of the Purchaser. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(s) <U>Information</U>. Other than any of the following containing information provided or prepared by an Obligor, the certifications of the
Seller, and all other written information, reports, certificates and statements (other than projections and forward-looking statements) furnished by or on behalf of the Seller for purposes of or in connection with this Agreement, the other Facility
Documents or the transactions contemplated hereby or thereby are true, complete and correct in all material respects as of the date such information is stated or certified. All projections and forward-looking statements furnished by or on behalf of
the Seller were prepared reasonably and in good faith as of the date on which they were provided. All written information, reports, certificates and statements (other than projections and forward-looking statements) provided or prepared by an
Obligor or any other third party (or derived therefrom) and furnished by or on behalf of the Seller to any Secured Party for purposes of or in connection with this Agreement, the other Facility Documents or the transactions contemplated hereby or
thereby are, to the actual knowledge of the Seller, true, complete and correct in all material respects as of the date such information is stated or certified. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(t) <U>Compliance with Agreements, Laws, Etc</U>. The Seller has complied in all material respects with all Applicable Laws relating to the

so could not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 4.2 <U>Representations and Warranties of the Seller
Relating to the Transferred Assets</U>. The Seller represents and warrants to the Purchaser as of the date hereof and each Conveyance Date: </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-10- </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Binding Obligation</U>. This Agreement and each of the Facility Documents to which the Purchaser is a party constitutes the legal, valid
and binding obligation of the Purchaser, enforceable against it in accordance with their respective terms, except as the enforceability hereof and thereof may be limited by Debtor Relief Laws and by general principles of equity (whether such
enforceability is considered in a proceeding in equity or at law). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <U>No Consents Required</U>. No consent of any other party and no
consent, license, approval or authorization of, or registration or declaration with, any Governmental Authority, bureau or agency is required in connection with the execution, delivery or performance by the Purchaser of this Agreement or any
Facility Document to which it is a party or the validity or enforceability of this Agreement or any such Facility Document other than in each case (x)&nbsp;such as have been met or obtained and are in full force and effect or (y)&nbsp;where failure
to do so would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) <U>No Violation</U>. The execution, delivery and

certificate of limited partnership or limited partnership agreement of the Purchaser or (iii)&nbsp;violate any material contract or other material agreement to which the Purchaser is a party or by which the Purchaser or any property or assets of the
Purchaser may be bound. </P>

<U>Section</U><U>s</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.1</U>, <U>4.2</U> and <U>4.3</U> are true and correct on and as of such day as though made on and as of such day. The representations and warranties set forth in <U>Section</U><U>s</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;4.1</U>,
<U>4.2</U> and<U> 4.3</U> shall survive (i)&nbsp;the Conveyance of the Transferred Assets to the Purchaser, (ii)&nbsp;the termination of the rights and obligations of the Purchaser and the Seller under this Agreement and (iii)&nbsp;the termination
of the rights and obligations of the Purchaser under the Credit Agreement. Upon discovery by a Responsible Officer of the Purchaser or the Seller of a breach of any of the foregoing representations and warranties in any material respect, the party
discovering such breach shall give prompt written notice to the other and to the Administrative Agent. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE V </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>COVENANTS OF THE SELLER </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 5.1 <U>Covenants of the Seller</U>. The Seller hereby covenants and agrees with the Purchaser that, from the date hereof, and until
all amounts owed by the Seller pursuant to this Agreement have been paid in full (other than as expressly survive the termination of this Agreement), unless the Purchaser otherwise consents in writing: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <U>Compliance with Agreements, Laws, Etc.</U> The Seller shall (i)&nbsp;duly observe and comply in all material respects with all
Applicable Laws relative to the conduct of its business or to its assets, (ii)&nbsp;preserve and keep in full force and effect its legal existence, (iii)&nbsp;preserve and keep in full force and effect its rights, privileges, qualifications and
franchises, except where the failure to do so could not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect, (iv)&nbsp;comply with the terms and conditions of each Facility Document to which it is a party, (v)&nbsp;comply with the terms
and conditions of its governing documents except where the failure to do so would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect and (vi)&nbsp;obtain, maintain and keep in full force and effect all authorizations and filings required
by a Governmental Authority or Private Authorizations which are necessary to properly carry out its business and the transactions contemplated to be performed by it under the Facility Documents to which it is a party and its governing documents,
except, in the case of clause&nbsp;(vi) above, where the failure to do so would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Cash Management Systems: Deposit of Collections</U>. The Seller shall transfer, or cause to be transferred, all Collections to the
Collection Accounts by the close of business on the Business Day following the date such Collections are received. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-12- </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) <U>Books and Records</U>. The Seller shall keep proper books of record and account in
which full and correct entries shall be made of all financial transactions and the assets and business of the Seller with respect to its transactions with Purchaser in accordance with GAAP, maintain and implement administrative and operating
procedures and keep and maintain all documents, books, records and other information necessary or reasonably advisable and relating to the Transferred Assets prior to their Conveyance hereunder for the collection of all Transferred Assets. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) <U>Accounting of Purchases</U>. Other than for tax and consolidated accounting purposes, the Seller will not account for or treat the
transactions contemplated hereby in any manner other than as a sale or contribution of the Transferred Assets by the Seller to the Purchaser; <U>provided</U> that the Purchaser is treated as a &#8220;disregarded entity&#8221; for U.S. federal income
tax purposes and, therefore, the transfer of Transferred Assets by the Seller to the Purchaser hereunder will not be recognized. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e)
<U>Liens</U>. The Seller shall not create, incur, assume or permit to exist any Lien on or with respect to any of its rights under any of the Facility Documents or on or with respect to any of its rights in the Transferred Assets, in each case other
than Permitted Liens. For the avoidance of doubt, this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;5.1(e)</U> shall not apply to any property retained by the Seller and not Conveyed or purported to be Conveyed hereunder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(f) <U>Change of Name. Etc.</U> The Seller shall not change its name (including by adding any French only name, combined French/English name
and/or English/French name), identity or corporate structure, or the location of its chief executive office, principal place of business or registered office, in any manner that would make any financing statement, financing change statement or
continuation statement filed by the Seller (or by the Administrative Agent on behalf of the Seller) in accordance with <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.1(b)</U> seriously misleading or that would impair the effectiveness of any UCC financing
statement filed by the Seller (or by the Administrative Agent on behalf of the Seller) in accordance with <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.1(b)</U> or change its jurisdiction of organization, unless the Seller shall have given the Purchaser at least
30 days prior written notice thereof, and shall promptly file appropriate financing change statements and amendments to all previously filed financing statements, financing change statement and continuation statements. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(g) <U>Sale Characterization</U>. The Seller shall not make statements or disclosures, or treat the transactions contemplated by this Agreement
(other than for tax or consolidated accounting purposes) in any manner other than as a true sale, contribution and absolute assignment of the title to and sole record and beneficial ownership interest of the Transferred Loans Conveyed or purported
to be Conveyed hereunder; <U>provided</U> that the Seller may consolidate the Purchaser and/or its properties and other assets for accounting purposes in accordance with GAAP if any consolidated financial statements of the Seller contain footnotes
that the Transferred Loans have been sold or otherwise transferred to the Purchaser. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(h) <U>Commingling</U>. The Seller shall not, and
shall not permit any of its Affiliates to, deposit or permit the deposit of any funds that do not constitute Principal Proceeds and Interest Proceeds or other proceeds of any Collateral Loans into the Collection Accounts. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) <U>Ownership</U>. At all times, the Seller shall, on an ongoing basis, maintain ownership of 100% of the outstanding limited partnership
units of the Purchaser. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE VI </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CONDITIONS PRECEDENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 6.1 <U>Conditions Precedent</U>. The obligations of the Purchaser to pay the Asset Purchase Price for the Transferred Assets sold on
any Conveyance Date shall be subject to the satisfaction of the following conditions: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) All representations and warranties of the Seller
contained in this Agreement shall be true and correct in all material respects as of such Conveyance Date (except to the extent such representations and warranties expressly relate to any earlier date, in which case such representations and
warranties shall be true and correct in all material respects as of such earlier date as if made on such date); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Seller shall have
performed in all material respects all obligations required to be performed by it pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement relating to such Transferred Assets as of such date; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The Seller shall have either filed, caused to be filed or provided in form suitable for filing the financing statement(s) required to be
filed pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.1(b); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(d) All corporate and legal proceedings, and all instruments in connection with the transactions
contemplated by this Agreement and the other Facility Documents shall be reasonably satisfactory in form and substance to the Purchaser, and the Purchaser shall have received from the Seller copies of all documents (including records of corporate
proceedings) relevant to the transactions herein contemplated as the Purchaser may reasonably have requested; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(e) No applicable law
shall prohibit or enjoin, and no order, judgment or decree of any federal, state or local court or governmental body, agency or instrumentality shall prohibit or enjoin, the making of any such purchase by the Purchaser in accordance with this
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE VII </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>REPURCHASE OR SUBSTITUTION OF INELIGIBLE COLLATERAL LOANS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 7.1 <U>Repurchase or Substitution of Ineligible Collateral Loans</U>. If any Transferred Loan is an Ineligible Collateral Loan as of
the Conveyance Date, resulting in a breach of representation under Section&nbsp;4.2(a) for such Transferred Loan, then no later than fifteen (15)&nbsp;Business Days following the earlier of knowledge by the Seller thereof or receipt by the Seller
from the Administrative Agent or the Purchaser of written notice thereof, the Seller shall either: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">repurchase such Ineligible Collateral Loan for a price at least equal to (i)&nbsp;during the Reinvestment
Period, the amount by which the Maximum Advance Rate Test is not satisfied that is attributable to such Ineligible Collateral Loan (determined by reference to the most recent Borrowing Base Calculation Statement) and (ii)&nbsp;after the end of the
Reinvestment Period, the product of (x)&nbsp;the Asset Purchase Price (as a percentage of par) for such Ineligible Collateral Loan <U>multiplied by</U> (y)&nbsp;the Principal Balance of such Ineligible Collateral Loan (the &#8220;<U>Repurchase
Price</U>&#8221;); </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">substitute for such Ineligible Collateral Loan a Substitute Loan in accordance with Section&nbsp;10.03 of the
Credit Agreement; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-14- </P>

</DIV></Center>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="9%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">cause such Transferred Loan to be an Eligible Collateral Loan; </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><I>provided </I>that the Seller shall not be required to comply with Section&nbsp;7.1(i), (ii) or (iii)&nbsp;if the Maximum Advance Rate Test is satisfied
notwithstanding such Transferred Loan being an Ineligible Collateral Loan and the Administrative Agent, in its sole discretion, consents thereto. For the avoidance of doubt, the Seller shall not be obligated to repurchase or substitute any
Ineligible Collateral Loan if the breach of representation under Section&nbsp;4.2(a) with respect to such Transferred Loan is cured in accordance with Section&nbsp;7.1(iii). Such repurchase and substitution obligations constitute the sole remedy for
a breach of Section&nbsp;4.2(a). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Upon payment of the Repurchase Price into the Collection Account (if required) for an Ineligible
Collateral Loan or the sale, contribution, transfer, assignment, setting over or other conveyance of a Substitute Loan for an Ineligible Collateral Loan, the Purchaser shall, automatically and without further action be deemed to transfer, assign and
set over to the Seller, without recourse, representation or warranty of any kind, except as to the absence of Liens, charges or encumbrances created by or arising solely as a result of actions of the Purchaser or the Collateral Agent, all the right,
title and interest of the Purchaser in, to and under such Ineligible Collateral Loan and all future monies due or to become due with respect thereto and all Collateral related thereto. Such Ineligible Collateral Loans shall no longer thereafter be
part of the Transferred Loans or the Collateral. The Purchaser shall (and shall request the Collateral Agent to), at the sole expense of the Seller, execute such documents and instruments of transfer as may be prepared by the Seller and take such
other actions as may be reasonably requested by the Seller in order to effect the transfer of such Collateral Loan pursuant to this Section&nbsp;7.1. Such Conveyance shall be a sale outright, and not for security. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">It is understood and agreed that the obligation (if any) of the Seller to purchase the Ineligible Collateral Loans or substitute a Substitute
Loan for such Ineligible Collateral Loans is not intended to, and shall not, constitute a guaranty of the collectability or payment of any Collateral Loan which is not collected, not paid or uncollectible on account of the insolvency, bankruptcy or
financial inability to pay of the related Obligor. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE VIII </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.1 <U>Amendments, Etc.</U> This Agreement and the rights and obligations of the parties hereunder may not be amended, supplemented,
waived or otherwise modified except in an instrument in writing signed by the Purchaser and the Seller and consented to in writing by the Administrative Agent. Any reconveyance executed in accordance with the provisions hereof shall not be
considered an amendment or modification to this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.2 <U>Governing Law: Submission to Jurisdiction</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) THIS AGREEMENT AND THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES UNDER THIS AGREEMENT AND ANY CLAIM, CONTROVERSY, DISPUTE OR CAUSE OF ACTION
(WHETHER IN CONTRACT OR TORT OR OTHERWISE) BASED UPON, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT AND THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY SHALL BE GOVERNED BY AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-15- </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Each party hereto hereby irrevocably submits and attorns to the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-exclusive</FONT> jurisdiction of any New York State or Federal court sitting in New York City in any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to the Facility Documents, and each party hereto hereby irrevocably
agrees that all claims in respect of such action or proceeding may be heard and determined in such New York State court or, to the extent permitted by law, in such Federal court. The parties hereto hereby irrevocably waive, to the fullest extent
they may effectively do so, the defense of an inconvenient forum to the maintenance of such action or proceeding. The parties hereto agree that a final judgment in any such action or proceeding shall be conclusive and may be enforced in other
jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or in any other manner provided by law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.3 <U>Notices</U>. All notices and other
communications provided for hereunder shall, unless otherwise stated herein, be in writing (including facsimile communication) and shall be personally delivered or sent by certified mail, electronic mail, postage prepaid, or by facsimile, to the
intended party at the address or facsimile number of such party set forth in the Credit Agreement. All such notices and communications shall be effective, (a)&nbsp;if personally delivered, when received, (b)&nbsp;if sent by certified mail, three
Business Days after having been deposited in the mail, postage prepaid, (c)&nbsp;if sent by <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">two-day</FONT> mail, two Business Days after having been deposited in the mail, postage prepaid, (d)&nbsp;if sent by
overnight courier, one Business Day after having been given to such courier, and (e)&nbsp;if transmitted by email, when sent, receipt confirmed by telephone or electronic means. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.4 <U>Severability of Provisions</U>. If any one or more of the covenants, agreements, provisions or terms of this Agreement shall
for any reason whatsoever be held invalid, then such covenants, agreements, provisions, or terms shall be deemed severable from the remaining covenants, agreements, provisions, or terms of this Agreement and shall in no way affect the validity or
enforceability of the other provisions of this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.5 <U>Assignment</U>. The Purchaser and the Seller each agree that at
any time and from time to time, at the Purchaser&#8217;s expense and upon reasonable request of the Administrative Agent or the Document Custodian, it shall promptly execute and deliver all further instruments and documents, and take all reasonable
further action, that is necessary or desirable to perfect and protect the Conveyances and security interests granted or purported to be granted by this Agreement or to enable the Collateral Agent or any of the Secured Parties to exercise and enforce
its rights and remedies under this Agreement with respect to any Transferred Assets. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Seller authorizes the filing of such financing or continuation statements, or amendments thereto, and such
other instruments or notices as may be necessary or desirable or that the Purchaser or the Document Custodian (acting solely at the Administrative Agent&#8217;s request) may reasonably request to protect and preserve the Conveyances and security
interests granted by this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.6 <U>Further Assurances</U>. The Purchaser and the Seller agree to do and perform, from
time to time, any and all acts and to execute any and all further instruments reasonably requested by the other party more fully to effect the purposes of this Agreement and the other Facility Documents, including the execution of any financing
statements or continuation statements or equivalent documents relating to the Transferred Loans for filing under the provisions of the UCC or other laws of any applicable jurisdiction. The Purchaser and the Seller hereby severally authorize the
Document Custodian, upon receipt of written direction from the Administrative Agent, to file one or more financing or continuation statements, and amendments thereto, relating to all or any part of the Transferred Assets. The Seller shall furnish to
the Document Custodian and the Administrative Agent from time to time such statements and such other reports in connection with the Transferred Assets as the Document Custodian (acting solely at the Administrative Agent&#8217;s request) or the
Administrative Agent may reasonably request, all in reasonable detail. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">-16- </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.7 <U>No Waiver; Cumulative Remedies</U>. No failure to exercise and no delay in
exercising, on the part of the Purchaser, the Seller or the Administrative Agent, any right, remedy, power or privilege hereunder, shall operate as a waiver thereof; nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right, remedy, power or privilege
hereunder preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, remedy, power or privilege. The rights, remedies, powers and privileges herein provided are cumulative and not exhaustive of any rights, remedies, powers
and privilege provided by law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.8 <U>Counterparts</U>. This Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts including
telecopy transmission thereof (and by different parties on separate counterparts), each of which shall be an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Signature pages to this Agreement may be delivered by <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> with a pdf copy or other replicating image attached, and any printed or copied version of any signature page so delivered will have the same force and effect as an originally signed signature page. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION 8.9 <U>Binding Effect; Third-Party Beneficiaries</U>. This Agreement and the other Facility Documents will inure to the benefit of and
be binding upon the parties hereto and their respective successors and permitted assigns. The Administrative Agent, for the benefit of the Secured Parties, is intended by the parties hereto to be a third-party beneficiary of this Agreement. The
parties hereto agree and acknowledge that simultaneously with the execution and delivery of this Agreement (i)&nbsp;the Purchaser will grant a security interest in all of its right, title and interest in this Agreement to the Document Custodian, for
the benefit of the Secured Parties, to which such security interest the Seller hereby expressly consents and (ii)&nbsp;the Document Custodian, for the benefit of the Secured Parties, may, following the occurrence and during the continuance of an
Event of Default, enforce the obligations of the Seller hereunder on behalf of the Purchaser without joinder of the Purchaser. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">SECTION
8.10 <U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-Petition;</FONT> Limited Recourse.</U> The Seller covenants and agrees that, prior to the date that is one year and one day (or, if longer, any applicable preference period and one day) after the payment
in full of all Transferred Loans (other than contingent reimbursement and indemnification obligations which are unknown, unmatured and for which no claim has been made), no party hereto shall institute against, or join any other Person in
instituting against, the Purchaser any bankruptcy, reorganization, arrangement, insolvency or liquidation proceeding or other similar proceedings under any federal, provincial, territorial, state or foreign bankruptcy or similar laws. In addition,
the Seller shall have no recourse for any amounts payable or any other obligations arising under this Agreement against any officer, member, director, employee, partner, Affiliate or security holder of the Purchaser or any of its successors or
assigns. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[REMAINDER OF PAGE INTENTIONALLY LEFT BLANK] </P>
